gloss: to refuse; to reject; to resist

definitions.explanation: To firmly say no to a request or offer.
To not accept or not allow something.
To stand against or prevent something from happening.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{申|もう}し{出|で}を{拒|こば}んだ。
{協力|きょうりょく}を{拒|こば}む{理由|りゆう}はない。
examples.english: There's no reason to refuse cooperation.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{何度|なんど}も{頼|たの}んだが、{最後|さいご}まで{頑|がん}として{拒|こば}み{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: I asked my father many times, but he stubbornly kept refusing until the end.

examples.japanese: {入国|にゅうこく}を{拒|こば}まれた。
examples.english: I was denied entry into the country.

examples.japanese: その{店|みせ}は{未成年|みせいねん}の{入場|にゅうじょう}を{拒|こば}んでいる。
{審査|しんさ}{委員会|いいんかい}は{書類|しょるい}に{不備|ふび}があるとして、{彼|かれ}の{申請|しんせい}を{拒|こば}んだ。
examples.english: The review committee rejected his application, citing incomplete documents.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}が{変化|へんか}を{拒|こば}んでいる。
{住民|じゅうみん}たちは{開発|かいはつ}{計画|けいかく}を{拒|こば}んだ。
examples.english: The residents blocked the development plan.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}にわたって{地域|ちいき}の{人々|ひとびと}が{一丸|いちがん}となり、{大型|おおがた}ショッピングモールの{建設|けんせつ}を{拒|こば}み{続|つづ}けてきた。
examples.english: For many years, the local people have united to resist the construction of a large shopping mall.

notes:
{拒|こば}む is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}). There is no common intransitive pair.

ASPECT ({ている}):
{拒|こば}んでいる indicates a continuing state of refusal or rejection.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {申|もう}し{出|で}を{拒|こば}む - to refuse an offer
- {入場|にゅうじょう}/{入国|にゅうこく}を{拒|こば}む - to deny entry
- {協力|きょうりょく}を{拒|こば}む - to refuse cooperation
- {拒|こば}み{続|つづ}ける - to keep refusing

{拒|こば}む VS {断|ことわ}る:
- {拒|こば}む is more formal and literary, implying firm rejection
- {断|ことわ}る is more common in everyday speech and can be polite refusal
- {拒|こば}む often implies resistance or stubborn refusal

RELATED WORDS:
- {拒否|きょひ} - refusal, rejection (noun)
- {拒絶|きょぜつ} - rejection (stronger)
